title: Fragments on Ezekiel
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria's comments on single verses of Ezekiel, kept in the catenae: the wings of the living creatures, the disciples as doves on the mountains, why Noah, Daniel and Job are named, the cedar shoot planted from David's line, the ordinances that were not good, the Levites who fed on the flock and muddied its water, and the promise of one shepherd, which Cyril reads of Christ. A fresh English translation from the Greek.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 70 (Fragmenta in Ezechielem). No published English version was used for its wording.
